## Why This Is Asked

```python
# PII redaction preprocessor sketch
import re
from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin

class PiiRedactor(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    def transform(self, X):
        return [re.sub(r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b', 'REDACTED_SSN', s) for s in X]
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example
```javascript
import { SageMakerRuntime } from 'aws-sdk';
const sagemaker = new SageMakerRuntime();
async function invoke(tenantId, modelName, payload) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  return sagemaker.invokeEndpoint({
    EndpointName: 'fraud-mme-endpoint',
    ContentType: 'application/json',
    Accept: 'application/json',
    CustomAttributes: `tenant_id=${tenantId};model_name=${modelName}`,
    Body: body
  }).promise();
}
```
